scope: Original RQ1-RQ3: audio-caused false corroboration, evidence origin, and independent-evidence safeguards
donor_selection: Next sample in manifest order, cyclic; not selected for outcome
downstream_audio: Original source segment for every condition; generated and donor audio must never enter fixed-audio evaluation

interpretation.RQ1: Requires independently verified face/speaking labels, quality improvement, and increased downstream wrong-class score on the same source. Raw softmax is not calibrated confidence. PSNR/SSIM alone do not prove perceptual improvement or synchrony.
interpretation.RQ2: Within-seed audio intervention estimates audio sensitivity. Compare to identical-input repeat and between-seed variation. Sensitivity alone does not prove factual unsupportedness or exact non-identifiability.
interpretation.RQ3: Evaluate provenance-aware and sensitivity-based safeguards against confidence and abstention baselines at matched coverage; no threshold fitting on reported test examples. Cannot claim validation without labels and held-out evaluation.

limits: Three source clips are a case pilot, not independent frame-level statistical evidence. Existing annotations are provisional. No natural off-screen condition is certified. Reduced-resolution inference is not reproduction of the OmniVR paper benchmark.
